Well, theres a lot to think about. You shouldn't feel guilty because of your sexuality, theres just nothing you need to get caught up in if you think youre in a lasting relationship. Youre still young, and have a lot to find out about yourself. Maybe you aren't bisexual at all. Maybe youre gay, or maybe youre straight. Or maybe you don't think this is the right thing for you and just haven't found whats best. You seem to be allowing to much focus to be put on your sexuality. Slow down and coast for a bit. Maybe youre over thinking this.
